## PR evidence

Complete [Record PR evidence](../docs/contributing/ci.md#record-pr-evidence) here or link a report containing its revision fields, per-command/platform rows, and mandatory and conditional checklists.

- Evidence report:
- Selected CI outcome (`pass` / `fail` / `not run` / `blocked`), profile, and run:
- Broader acceptance outcome (`pass` / `fail` / `not run` / `blocked`):
- Outstanding requirements, skips with reasons, and blockers / next actions:

- [ ] Evidence identifies immutable head, base, merge-base, tested commit/tree, and combined head-plus-base commit/tree from a clean checkout.
- [ ] Evidence is current for this head and base; each required suite/platform has an outcome, test counts, and retained logs/artifacts.
- [ ] Mandatory and applicable conditional requirements pass; missing, skipped, blocked, and unexecuted evidence is explicitly reported.
- [ ] Required selected CI passes. This report does not override CI or branch protection.
